# The exams {.unnumbered}

These are the three versions of the midterm exam, as they were given on paper.

| Version | Question 1 starts | PDF | Word |
|:---:|---|---|---|
| A | "The task app is written with Next.js, which is a framework. …" | [PDF](exams/midterm-f26-version-A.pdf) | [Word](exams/midterm-f26-version-A.docx) |
| B | "What does it mean to distill an AI model? …" | [PDF](exams/midterm-f26-version-B.pdf) | [Word](exams/midterm-f26-version-B.docx) |
| C | "You have step-by-step instructions, plus a small program, …" | [PDF](exams/midterm-f26-version-C.pdf) | [Word](exams/midterm-f26-version-C.docx) |

The three versions have the same questions and the same answer choices, in a different order. The PDF files
were made from the Word files.
